subject: Geopolitics
title: Chemical Weapons Ban
description: A quick win: understand Chemical Weapons Ban.

hook.text: Sarin gas killed 1,400 people in Syria in 2013. The chemical weapons ban existed on paper. Enforcement was absent.

buildup.text: The Chemical Weapons Convention bans production and use. 193 states signed it. Syria and a few others didn't comply.

discovery.text: The CWC succeeded in destroying 98% of declared stockpiles. Verification works when states cooperate.

twist.text: Russia used Novichok nerve agent on a former spy in the UK in 2018. A signatory violated its own treaty openly.

climax.text: The CWC has no enforcement mechanism beyond naming and shaming. Against defiant states, shame isn't enough.

punchline.text: Banning a weapon doesn't remove the will to use it.

quiz.question: What is the main weakness of the Chemical Weapons Convention?
options: Too few nations have signed it
It lacks an enforcement mechanism beyond naming and shaming
Chemical weapons are impossible to detect
